## Contribution type

- [ ] Standard change (new/modified normative requirements)
- [ ] Implementation guidance (non-normative)
- [ ] Case study
- [ ] Issue / gap report
- [ ] Site / tooling

## Standards checklist (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] **Scope**: linked to `00_foundations/scope_and_non_scope.md` (or scope update proposed)
- [ ] **Ethical mapping**: references at least one axiom ID (`A1`–`A7`)
- [ ] **Normative language**: MUST/SHOULD/MAY used only for requirements
- [ ] **Risk tiers**: highest affected tier (0–3) stated with rationale
- [ ] **Evidence**: Compliance Evidence section added/updated
- [ ] **Traceability Table** present (required for `01_`–`05_` docs)
- [ ] **Change Log** updated
- [ ] Versioning impact (MAJOR / MINOR / PATCH) stated per `VERSIONING.md`
